## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

WatchApp — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/MainActivity.kt

## Trigger

Recomposition of WatchApp on each frame, for the MAIN, PROJECTION and
CONTROL branches of the `when (destination)` block — observed

## Today

In `WatchApp`, the `MAIN`, `PROJECTION` and `CONTROL` branches each
call `raceRecordingRepository.findInProgress().getOrNull()` directly
in the composable body, as a plain (non-suspend) synchronous call —
see `RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.findInProgress()`, a synchronized
in-memory read. The `MAIN` branch additionally calls
`sensorPermissionManager.isGranted()` (`SensorPermissionManager.kt`,
itself delegating to `SensorPermissionSystem.isGranted()`) the same
way. None of these four calls is wrapped in `remember`,
`rememberSaveable`, `produceState` or any other mechanism that would
cache the result across recompositions; each call therefore re-runs on
every recomposition of `WatchApp`, not only when `destination`
changes.

## Expected

In each of the `MAIN`, `PROJECTION` and `CONTROL` branches,
`raceRecordingRepository.findInProgress()` is read once per entry into
that branch (i.e. once per value of `destination`), its result held in
a `remember(destination) { ... }` (or equivalent) rather than
re-invoked on every recomposition. In the `MAIN` branch,
`sensorPermissionManager.isGranted()` is likewise read once per entry
into that branch and held in a `remember`, not re-invoked on every
recomposition.
